# runtime-catalog

The closed list of conversation runtimes (`CONVERSATION_RUNTIMES`: today only
`sdk`) and `DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_RUNTIME`, as plain data — id, label,
description. A leaf both halves read: the runtime registry and a conversation
row's `runtime` are typed by it. The `ConversationRuntime` contract stays the
seam a future runtime plugs into; the tmux runtime that sat beside sdk was
retired (`research/2026-10-20-conversations-sdk-default-and-tmux-removal.md`).
